reason: A DSH orchestration plugin that applies deterministic keyword-based model routing and provides an optional isolated image-generation channel.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于关键词的确定性模型路由，并支持可选的隔离式生图通道。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with deterministic keyword-based model routing and an optional isolated image-generation channel.

capabilities: Applies deterministic keyword rules to select configured language models
Provides an optional allowlisted model_route tool for model switching
Connects to an OpenAI-compatible image generation endpoint
Downloads generated image results from configured hosts
